realmAbilities.name: Volley
realmAbilities.delve:
Ground-targetted archery attack that fires successive arrows at a random target in a given area. To use this ability, choose a ground target. This target must be at least 66% of your bow's normal max range away from you.
Once you are ready to fire, you can fire up to 5 arrows by hitting your bow button in succession.

Target: Ground
Range: Minimum 66% of player range.
